narrative.overview: A calm daylight interface connects separate Chat and Finance screens through one invoice. Bottom navigation becomes a desktop rail at 960px; the two screens remain separate.

rules.name: The State Rule
rules.body: A selected route, a resolved fee question and a verified signature have distinct text, not color alone.

dos: Do preserve aligned money columns and explicit currency context.
Do keep Chat and Finance separate and retain the invoice link between them.
donts: Don't imply that a signature verifies a person's legal identity.
